component.name: All3DScan
component.summary: Native Linux scanning app for Revopoint, Creality and Einstar scanners

description.p: Clean-room open-source Linux scanning application with a Revo Scan-style dark interface. Captures data from consumer structured-light 3D scanners (Revopoint, Creality, Einstar) on Ubuntu and related distributions, using a native C++/Qt acquisition shell with Python/Open3D processing workers.
Revo Scan-style dark UI, multi-vendor device detection, and hybrid Python meshing bridge.
